summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, attaching a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange detailing movements in authorized and issued share capital for April 2026. The report shows no change in Class Y or Class Z authorized shares, and a negligible increase of 5,000 Class Z ordinary shares issued. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine regulatory filing regarding share capital movements.
